versions.content: Dcm internal processing of secure coding validation routine If the Dcm receives the routine control service referred by DcmSecureCodingVali- dationRoutine , the Dcm shall process the routine control inside the Dcm and does neither create nor call the external C-Function interface [SWS_Dcm_01203].
